propositions: A new peer-confirmation record store must persist (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) keyed events with link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, and source fields to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones in removal paths.

The confirmation write seam must fire after set_relationship succeeds in _update_one_dispatch_links via an optional link_confirm callback that swallows exceptions without perturbing link counts or breaking already-landed outbound links.

Unbound targets (when binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must be skipped entirely rather than persisting vendor keys in local-id fields, and the target must be reverse-mapped from to_key before recording.

The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames in reconcile_helpers so confirmation-only changes are not dropped by the per-file idempotency guard during snapshot commits.
The store must survive ticket-log snapshot compaction and gracefully degrade to empty state on corrupt or absent load without raising exceptions.
